description: This PHP source file defines the PIMLeftMenuService class, which manages the left menu system for the Employee module in the OrangeHRM system. It handles retrieval, caching, and permission checks for menu items related to employee personal information, contact details, job info, etc., with support for localization and configuration integration.

classes.name: PIMLeftMenuService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing the left navigation menu for the Personal Information Management (PIM) module in OrangeHRM, including permission checks, caching, and menu item generation based on user roles and employee data.

methods.name: getEmployeeService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an EmployeeService instance for handling employee data operations.

methods.name: setEmployeeService
methods.description: Injects an EmployeeService instance for dependency management or testing.

methods.name: getMenuItems
methods.description: Retrieves menu items for a specific employee, utilizing cache when available, or generating new menu data when cache is empty.

methods.name: clearCachedMenu
methods.description: Clears cached menu data for a specific employee or all employees if no employee number is provided.

methods.name: isPimAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the PIM menu is accessible for a particular employee, based on permissions.

methods.name: generateMenuItems
methods.description: Generates menu items for an employee considering permission and workflow state, used internally by getMenuItems.

methods.name: isEmployeeWorkflowActionsAllowed
methods.description: Determines if actions related to employee workflow states are permitted for the specified employee.

methods.name: getMenuFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves the employee's menu from session cache.

methods.name: saveMenuInCache
methods.description: Stores the generated menu for an employee into the session cache.

methods.name: getAvailableActions
methods.description: Returns the list of available menu actions, optionally excluding tax menu items based on configuration.

methods.name: isTaxMenuEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether the tax exemptions menu is enabled via configuration, with caching.

methods.name: getPreparedMenuItems
methods.description: Prepares and formats menu items with URLs and active states for rendering in the UI.
